title: Palindrome Checker
description:
Check if the phrase `"A man a plan a canal Panama"` is a palindrome. To check: remove all spaces and punctuation, convert to lowercase, then compare with its reverse. Print `Yes` if it is a palindrome, `No` otherwise.

**Expected output:**
```
Yes
```

phrase = "A man a plan a canal Panama"
hint: Use a loop or list comprehension to keep only alphanumeric chars. Then compare cleaned[::-1] == cleaned.
